incident.title: Checkout latency spike after canary release
symptoms: p95 latency rose from 220ms to 2.8s in 12 minutes
error budget burn is above 8x for checkout SLO
support queue reports failed card authorizations
incident.suspected_change: Cloud Run revision checkout-api-00042-q7f received 20 percent traffic
incident.business_impact: Estimated 18 percent conversion drop for active retail cart sessions
constraints: No full rollback without incident commander approval
Do not expose payment PII in evidence
Prefer canary traffic shift before deploy revert
